## The problem

## Scope check

Some things are deliberate non-goals (see [README](../../README.md) and
[ARCHITECTURE.md](../../ARCHITECTURE.md)). Please confirm your request is not one
of these, or explain why it should be reconsidered:

- [ ] It does **not** involve sending mail (no SMTP — this is a safety boundary).
- [ ] It does **not** require autonomous/background behavior (cron, watchers, digests).
- [ ] It does **not** require multi-user support.
- [ ] It does **not** add a new iCloud service (Reminders, Notes, Photos).

Other approaches you thought about.
